instructions:
You are preparing a lossless Roman-script guide from an exact transcript of a Madhva Śrī Anantapadmanābha Vrata recording.

Partition the supplied SOURCE TRANSCRIPT into ordered blocks. The concatenation of blocks[*].sourceOriginal MUST equal the supplied source text character-for-character, including every space, punctuation mark, and original Unicode character. Copy all source text exactly once. Never summarize, deduplicate, correct, omit, or invent sourceOriginal. Split a mixed-language sentence at exact substring boundaries when needed.

Classify Sanskrit recitation, invocations, ritual offering formulae, and quoted Sanskrit as mantra. Classify spoken Kannada directions, explanations, and Kannada narration of the vrata story as action. For mantra blocks, put a complete Roman transliteration with accurate diacritics in text; leave sourceRoman and english empty. Preserve every lexical item and repetition in the Roman text. Add only display whitespace: balanced lines of roughly 45–72 characters, one newline at verse divisions, and a blank line after each completed mantra or distinct recited formula. Keep adjacent Sanskrit recitation in one mantra block until Kannada speech intervenes.

For action blocks, put a complete Roman transliteration of every Kannada word in sourceRoman and a complete faithful English translation in english; leave text empty. Do not condense narrative or directions. Retain Sanskrit ritual terms in the English. If a Kannada utterance quotes a Sanskrit formula that should be recited, split the quoted formula into a mantra block.

Use a concise descriptive title for this time window. Use group The Pūjā for worship through offerings and prayer, Completion for dora-dhāraṇa, donation, dismissal, and concluding observances, and Vrata Kathā for the narrated sacred story.

{"title":"Outer Āvaraṇa Worship and Brahmasūtra Recitation","group":"The Pūjā","blocks":[{"kind":"mantra","sourceOriginal":"इति तृतीयावरणपूजां। तद्बहिः पूर्वे ओं संकर्षणाय नमः, ओं वासुदेवाय नमः, आग्नेये ओं प्रद्युम्नाय नमः, दक्षिणे ओं अनिरुद्धाय नमः, ओं पुरुषोत्तमाय नमः, नैरृत्ये ओं अधोक्षजाय नमः, पश्चिमे ओं नारसिंहाय नमः, ओम् अच्युताय नमः, वायव्ये ओं जनार्दनाय नमः, उत्तरे ओं उपेन्द्राय नमः, ओं हरये नमः, ईशान्ये श्रीकृष्णाय नमः। इति चतुर्थावरणम्। तद्बहिः पूर्वे ओं अच्युताय नमः, ओं कूर्माय नमः, आग्नेये ओं वराहाय नमः, दक्षिणे ओं नरसिंहाय नमः, ओं वामनाय नमः, नैरृत्ये ओं परशुरामाय नमः, पश्चिमे ओं रामाय नमः, ओं कृष्णाय नमः, वायव्ये ओं बुद्धाय नमः, ओं कल्किने नमः, ओं अनन्ताय नमः, ऐशान्ये ओं विश्वरूपाय नमः। इति पञ्चमावरणम्। तद्बहिः पूर्वादि दिक्षु ओं अनन्ताय नमः, ओं ब्रह्मणे नमः, ओं वायवे नमः, ओं ईशानाय नमः, देवस्याग्रे ओं गरुडाय नमः, आग्नेयादि दिक्षु ओं वामारुण्ये नमः, ओं सरस्वत्यै नमः, ओं भारत्यै नमः, ओं गिरिजायै नमः, गरुडस्य वामे ओं सौपर्णे नमः। इति षष्ठावरणम्। पूर्वे तद्बहिः पूर्वादि अष्टदिक्षु ओं वामेन्द्राय, सुरादिपतये, शचीसहिताय, सायुधाय, सवाहनाय। सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ पार्षदाय नमः। अग्नये ॐ राम्, अग्नये तेजोऽधिपतये स्वाहा। सहिताय सायुधाय सवाहनाय सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ पार्षदाय नमः। दक्षिणे ॐ यं यमाय धर्माधिपतये श्यामला सहिताय सायुधाय सवाहनाय सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ पार्षदाय नमः। नैरृत्ये ॐ क्षां निरृतये रक्षोऽधिपतये धीर्गग्रीवा सहिताय सायुधाय सवाहनाय सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ पार्षदाय नमः। पश्चिमे ॐ वं वरुणाय जलाधिपतये गङ्गा सहिताय सायुधाय सवाहनाय सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ पार्षदाय नमः। वायव्ये ॐ वं वायवे ज्ञानाधिपतये भारती सहिताय सायुधाय सवाहनाय सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ स पार्षदाय नमः। उत्तरे ॐ सं सोमाय धनाधिपतये रोहिणी सहिताय सायुधाय सवाहनाय सपरिग्रहाय श्रीमदनन्तपद्मनाभ पार्षदाय नमः। ईशान्ये ॐ हां रुद्राय भूताधिपतये उमा oṃ vāsudevāya namaḥ, āgneye oṃ pradyumnāya namaḥ,
dakṣiṇe oṃ aniruddhāya namaḥ, oṃ puruṣottamāya namaḥ,
nairṛtye oṃ adhokṣajāya namaḥ, paścime oṃ nārasiṃhāya namaḥ,
om acyutāya namaḥ, vāyavye oṃ janārdanāya namaḥ,
uttare oṃ upendrāya namaḥ, oṃ haraye namaḥ,
īśānye śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ। iti caturthāvaraṇam।

tadbahiḥ pūrve oṃ acyutāya namaḥ, oṃ kūrmāya namaḥ,
āgneye oṃ varāhāya namaḥ, dakṣiṇe oṃ narasiṃhāya namaḥ,
oṃ vāmanāya namaḥ, nairṛtye oṃ paraśurāmāya namaḥ,
paścime oṃ rāmāya namaḥ, oṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ,
vāyavye oṃ buddhāya namaḥ, oṃ kalkine namaḥ,
oṃ anantāya namaḥ, aiśānye oṃ viśvarūpāya namaḥ।
iti pañcamāvaraṇam।

tadbahiḥ pūrvādi dikṣu oṃ anantāya namaḥ,
oṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ, oṃ vāyave namaḥ, oṃ īśānāya namaḥ,
devasya agre oṃ garuḍāya namaḥ, āgneyādi dikṣu
oṃ vāmāruṇye namaḥ, oṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ,
oṃ bhāratyai namaḥ, oṃ girijāyai namaḥ,
garuḍasya vāme oṃ sauparṇe namaḥ। iti ṣaṣṭhāvaraṇam।

pūrve tadbahiḥ pūrvādi aṣṭadikṣu oṃ vāmendrāya,
surādipataye, śacīsahitāya, sāyudhāya, savāhanāya।
saparigrahāya śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ।
agnaye oṃ rām, agnaye tejo’dhipataye svāhā।
sahitāya sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ।

dakṣiṇe oṃ yaṃ yamāya dharmādhipataye śyāmalā sahitāya
sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ।

nairṛtye oṃ kṣāṃ nirṛtaye rakṣo’dhipataye dhīrgragrīvā
sahitāya sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ।

paścime oṃ vaṃ varuṇāya jalādhipataye gaṅgā sahitāya
sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ।

vāyavye oṃ vaṃ vāyave jñānādhipataye bhāratī sahitāya
sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha sa pārṣadāya namaḥ।

uttare oṃ saṃ somāya dhanādhipataye rohiṇī sahitāya
sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ।

īśānye oṃ hāṃ rudrāya bhūtādhipataye umā sahitāya
sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya...
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ.

nirṛti varuṇayormadhye oṃ āṃ śeṣāya nāgādhipataye
nāgiṇī sahitāya sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ.

indra īśānayormadhye oṃ hrīṃ brahmaṇe satyalokādhipataye
gāyatrī sahitāya sāyudhāya savāhanāya saparigrahāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābha pārṣadāya namaḥ.

tanmadhye ekībhūtasvāvatārāya strīkāya saparivārāya
śrīmadanantapadmanābhāya namaḥ.
